verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation is an operating system, and an OS could plausibly offer AI-training opt-outs, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documented control, policy or setting that prevents user data from being used to train AI models. The only related statement is a general marketing line that 'your data belongs to you'. That is a broad privacy claim, not an AI-training opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
